name: Birjis Qadr
role: Proclaimed ruler of Awadh during the revolt
contribution: Birjis Qadr was proclaimed ruler of Awadh during the 1857 rebellion, with his mother Begum Hazrat Mahal acting as regent and leading resistance from Lucknow.
context: His proclamation restored a symbolic Awadh court after the Company's annexation of the kingdom. Political legitimacy, dynastic claims, and military resistance were closely connected in the Lucknow theatre.
impact: Birjis Qadr's short-lived rule shows how rebel leaders used restored courts and dynastic authority to organize opposition to British power.
highlight: Proclaimed ruler of Awadh during the 1857 rebellion under Begum Hazrat Mahal's regency.
